top_signals.title: US escalates Iran pressure with sanctions on crypto, aviation, shipping and gold as part of ‘economic D-Day’
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department is zeroing in on digital assets it says are being used to bolster Iran’s economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Goldman M&A, NHL Futures | ETF IQ 8/24/2026
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Byron Lake, Goldman Sachs Asset Management Global Co-Head of Third-Party Wealth, Troy Cates, NEOS Co-Founder, Frances Newton, Tuttle Capital Management CIO, Carlos Pena, Texas Capital Head of ETF and Funds Management, and Nick Samouilhan, Wellington Portfolio Manager. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Need 'All-Weather' Portfolio: Tuttle's Newton
top_signals.summary: Frances Newton, CIO of Tuttle Capital Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." They discuss a report that the US Treasury could draw down some of its cash pile to fund buybacks of higher-yielding older securities in a bid to tackle rising borrowing costs. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
